Explore historical data on top civil servants, governments, ministers, state secretaries and political advisors in Norway. The dashboard runs in your browser, so it can take up to half a minute to load the first time. The datasets, codebook and citation are on the [Data page](data.qmd). Disclaimer: The dashboard is currently being beta-tested, so errors in visualizations and statistics may occur.

<!--
How this page works:
- The dashboard itself is dashboard/app.R. Edit that file, not this page.
- When the page is rendered, dashboard/embed-app.lua puts app.R and the four
  datasets into the shinylive-r block below. Only this page does that work, so
  the rest of the website renders as before.
- The loading bar is plain HTML and JavaScript (below). It follows the progress
  messages that app.R prints in the browser and disappears when the first chart
  is drawn. If loading stalls, it offers to show the dashboard anyway and lists
  the last error messages. Opened as a file (file://), the dashboard cannot run,
  and the loading screen says so.
- search: false keeps the embedded app code out of the site's search index.
-->

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| components: [viewer]
#| viewerHeight: 1000
## embed-app: dashboard/app.R
## embed-data: TCS_NOR.RDS Ministers_NOR.RDS POLADV_NOR.RDS Governments_NOR.RDS
```

:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById('dashboard-app');
  var box = root && root.querySelector('.dash-loading');
  if (!box) return;
  var bar = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-bar');
  var track = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-track');
  var label = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-label');
  var note = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-note');
  var showButton = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-show');
  var details = box.querySelector('.dash-loading-details');

  // Loading happens in stages. Each stage fills part of the bar, easing towards
  // its end until the next stage is reached, so the bar never moves backwards.
  var order = ['start', 'r', 'data', 'app', 'connected'];
  var stages = {
    start:     { label: 'Downloading R for your browser…', end: 0.30, tau: 6 },
    r:         { label: 'Loading R packages…',            end: 0.65, tau: 9 },
    data:      { label: 'Preparing the data…',            end: 0.78, tau: 2 },
    app:       { label: 'Starting the dashboard…',        end: 0.88, tau: 4 },
    connected: { label: 'Drawing the charts…',            end: 0.99, tau: 3 }
  };
  var t0 = Date.now(), current = 'start', stageFrom = 0, stageT0 = t0;
  var progress = 0, finished = false, helpShown = false;
  var appAt = null, connectedAt = null, errors = [];

  function show() {
    bar.style.width = (100 * progress).toFixed(1) + '%';
    track.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.round(100 * progress)));
  }
  function setStage(key) {
    if (finished || order.indexOf(key) <= order.indexOf(current)) return;
    current = key; stageFrom = progress; stageT0 = Date.now();
    if (key === 'app') appAt = stageT0;
    label.textContent = stages[key].label;
    track.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', stages[key].label);
  }

  // Keep the last few error messages, to show if loading stalls.
  function remember(text) {
    text = String(text || '').replace(/^preload (error|echo):/, '').trim();
    if (!text || /Attaching package|is masked from|^page$|React DevTools/.test(text)) return;
    errors.push(text.slice(0, 300));
    if (errors.length > 6) errors.shift();
  }
  function showHelp(message) {
    helpShown = true;
    note.textContent = message;
    showButton.hidden = false;
    if (errors.length) {
      details.hidden = false;
      details.querySelector('pre').textContent = errors.join('\n');
    }
  }

  // The app runs in R inside the browser; its start-up messages (and the
  // progress messages in app.R) pass through the page console.
  var methods = ['log', 'info', 'warn', 'error'], originals = {};
  methods.forEach(function (m) {
    originals[m] = console[m];
    console[m] = function () {
      try {
        var text = Array.prototype.join.call(arguments, ' ');
        if (text.indexOf('dashboard-progress:app') >= 0) setStage('app');
        else if (text.indexOf('dashboard-progress:data') >= 0) setStage('data');
        else if (text.indexOf('R version') >= 0) setStage('r');
        else if (m === 'error' || m === 'warn') remember(text);
      } catch (e) {}
      return originals[m].apply(console, arguments);
    };
  });
  window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
    var src = e.target && (e.target.src || e.target.href);
    if (e.message) remember('Error: ' + e.message);
    else if (src && src.indexOf(location.origin) === 0) remember('Could not load ' + src);
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (e) {
    remember('Error: ' + ((e.reason && e.reason.message) || e.reason));
  });

  function finish(fast) {
    if (finished) return;
    finished = true;
    clearInterval(timer);
    methods.forEach(function (m) { console[m] = originals[m]; });
    progress = 1; show();
    setTimeout(function () {
      box.classList.add('done');
      setTimeout(function () { box.remove(); }, 450);
    }, fast ? 0 : 300);
  }
  showButton.addEventListener('click', function () { finish(true); });

  // The dashboard is ready when its first chart is drawn. As a fallback, the
  // loading screen also goes away shortly after the app is up, so it never
  // covers a running dashboard.
  function check() {
    if (root.querySelector('.loading-wrapper-error')) return finish(true);   // let Shinylive show its error
    var now = Date.now();
    if (connectedAt && now - connectedAt > 5000) return finish();
    if (appAt && now - appAt > 20000) return finish();
    var frame = root.querySelector('iframe');
    var w = null, d = null;
    try { w = frame && frame.contentWindow; d = w && w.document; } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!w || !d) return;
    var connected = false;
    try { connected = !!(w.Shiny && w.Shiny.shinyapp && w.Shiny.shinyapp.isConnected()); } catch (e) {}
    if (connected) {
      setStage('connected');
      if (!connectedAt) connectedAt = now;
    }
    if (d.querySelector('.shiny-plot-output img')) finish();
  }

  function tick() {
    if (finished) return;
    var now = Date.now(), s = stages[current];
    var p = stageFrom + (s.end - stageFrom) * (1 - Math.exp(-(now - stageT0) / 1000 / s.tau));
    if (p > progress) progress = p;
    show();
    check();
    if (finished || helpShown) return;
    if (!root.querySelector('iframe') && now - t0 > 40000) {
      label.textContent = 'The dashboard could not start';
      showHelp('Something stopped it from starting. Reloading the page may help.');
    } else if (now - t0 > 45000) {
      showHelp('This is taking longer than usual. You can wait, reload the page, or show the dashboard as it is.');
    }
  }

  // The dashboard runs R in the browser, which needs the page to come from a
  // web address (the website or Quarto's preview), not from a file on disk.
  if (location.protocol === 'file:' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
    label.textContent = 'The dashboard cannot run here';
    note.textContent = location.protocol === 'file:'
      ? 'This page was opened as a file. The dashboard only runs when the page comes from a web address: the published website, or the preview that Quarto opens when you render the site.'
      : 'This browser does not support the features the dashboard needs. Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.';
    track.hidden = true;
    return;
  }

  label.textContent = stages.start.label;
  var timer = setInterval(tick, 200);
})();
</script>
```
